426:t_021:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$n! You're the only one who can settle things with Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_021:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Whatever happens, you decide how this ends!!」

426:t_022:5.en:
$n
「...$$アドヴェント#pilot$$. I've always relied on you and Miss $$スズネ$$ until now...」

426:t_022:6.en:
$n
「But now... I'm at a point where I have to fight with my own strength!」

426:t_022:7.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「...It seems you don't need my help anymore.」

426:t_022:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$n... Let me see you fight.」

426:t_023:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Tch... That pretty boy.」

426:t_025:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「What a shame, $$バルビエル$$. $n isn't behaving the way you wanted.」

426:t_025:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Stay out of this. I'm the one who'll hunt down $n.」

426:t_025:4.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Tch... We've awakened someone troublesome.」

426:t_027:1.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「This $$ジェミニア#robot$$ has a pseudo-$$スフィア$$... Its position is the reverse of $$ジェニオン$$'s during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

426:t_027:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「While I'm at it... $$ジェミニア#robot$$ just wouldn't be complete without these guys.」

426:t_028:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「The nuisances are gone. Let's take our time and enjoy this, $n.」

426:t_028:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Sorry, Miss $$スズネ$$, but we're going to get in your way!」

426:t_028:4.en:
$$甲児$$
「I don't understand what's going on, but we won't let you take down $n!」

426:t_028:5.en:
$$正太郎$$
「We're going to stop you, Miss $$スズネ$$!」

426:t_028:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「And we'll get you to come back! Back to us!」

426:t_028:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ isn't just your teacher.」

426:t_028:9.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「That's right! She's the Volunteer Club's darling!」

426:t_028:11.en:
$$アルト$$
「We'll get Miss $$スズネ$$ back with all our strength combined!」

426:t_028:14.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You idiots make me laugh! Then I'll take care of all of you together!」

426:t_028:15.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Try to stop me if you can! I'm free now!」

426:t_029:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...That's enough for today. This should be plenty for an introduction.」

426:t_029:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「I'll take the $$スフィア$$ you've developed, just as it is. Half the power that brought the $$いがみ合う双子$$ this far was mine, after all.」

426:t_030:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「This is bad! $n's mind is already at its limit!」

426:t_030:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'll go! $$ランド$$, I need you to back me up!」

426:t_031:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's the $$悲しみの乙女$$.」

426:t_031:1.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! What are you planning to do!?」

426:t_031:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「But I'm not your opponent.」

426:t_032:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「It seems your emotions took over, and you were slow to notice me approaching.」

426:t_033:3.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It looks like she's fainted. How adorable.」

426:t_034:0.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Stay out of this, $$アムブリエル$$. $$セツコ$$ is mine.」

426:t_034:1.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I won't let you or $$アウストラリス$$ lay a hand on her.」

426:t_034:2.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's a bit of a shame, but I have other prey.」

426:t_034:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「See you, $n. Overcome the backlash before we meet again.」

426:t_034:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Wait, damn it, $$バルビエル$$!」

426:t_034:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Where are you taking $$セツコ$$?!」

426:t_034:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$... I'll wait for you there.」

426:t_035:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「$$バルビエル$$ and Miss $$スズネ$$ have withdrawn.」

426:t_035:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「We can't track them... We've lost them completely...」

426:t_035:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We know where they're going.」

426:t_035:3.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「$$セントラル・ベース$$ in the south of the Central Continent... It's $$サイデリアル$$'s last stronghold.」
